name: Fauquier County, VA
findings: Fauquier County has 342 nonprofit organizations. 130 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 107 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fauquier County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Fauquier County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 107 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Fauquier County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 58 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 10 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.
